title: Pi cost incognito tombstone
description: Payload the Pi extension POSTs to /api/ingest to toggle incognito mode for one session. It carries the session UUID and a boolean, nothing else — no cost, no cwd, no timing for the session. incognito: true records the tombstone, purges any rows already stored for that id, and blocks all future writes for it; incognito: false lifts the tombstone so the session may be reported again. The server rejects unknown keys.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. 3 is the tombstone shape; snapshots stay on 2.

sessionId.description: Pi session UUID from the session header.

incognito.description: true to tombstone (and purge), false to lift the tombstone.
